title: 采购承诺、收货、开票及付款敞口
learningObjective: 独立构建供应商五项金额报表，区分净开票与票面，识别连接重复，并按顺序分配合格收货以追查已付款异常发票。
concept: 采购承诺、合格收货、扣贷项净开票、实际付款及未付余额是不同业务事件的金额。各自先聚合到供应商，再对齐；未付余额是净开票减付款，并非未收货承诺。
syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC

executionSteps: 汇总采购承诺及合格收货
汇总净开票、付款及余额
useCase: 采购与财务需要截至2025年底按供应商对照承诺、合格收货、净开票、实付和未付余额，并识别已付款但三方不一致的发票。
comparison: 采购进度差额与应付余额不同；净开票与原始票面不同，三方匹配按原始票面和合格收货计价，不能混用净应付口径。

commonError.example: 直接连接采购行和发票行；每张发票重复使用全部合格收货量。
commonError.correction: 独立预聚合；按采购行和稳定发票顺序累计分配，按发票汇总后检查付款。

notes: 原主查询及结果 BP41.json 保持不变；需核实采购视图截止日期与快照口径。独立示例使用 SQLite 内联数据，未重新执行完整企业库、原生数据库或浏览器。

compatibility.detail: 本版本SQLite及sql.js WASM已实际复验，原生MySQL8.4尚未执行。

steps.label: 聚合采购行和发票余额

mergedFrom.title: 三方不一致且已经付款的发票

teaching.problem: 采购与财务需要截至2025年底按供应商对照承诺、合格收货、净开票、实付和未付余额，并识别已付款但三方不一致的发票。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 将采购行按供应商聚合，承诺为订购金额，收货为合格接收数量乘采购单价。b 将发票余额视图按供应商聚合，净开票已扣截止日前批准贷项，付款仅计截止日前发生的付款。两个汇总各自一供应商一行，再从供应商主档左连接，完整记录假设下缺失金额补零；按未付余额倒序。不能直接连接采购行与发票行，否则两笔采购与两张发票可形成四行。主查询未单独设置年度起点，沿用视图截至年底的累计口径，不应称为2025年度新增采购。追查已付款异常时切回采购行与发票行：按采购行分区，以发票日期、发票号与行编号确定先后，窗口累计此前开票量，当前分配量为不小于零的剩余合格数量与当前开票量的较小值。再按发票汇总原始票面、分配计价与数量差，付款在发票粒度判断，不累加重复的发票付款字段。此分配示例假定数量非负，发票顺序稳定，且为截止日已知收货的事后分配，不等于付款发生当时的收货状态。
teaching.resultExplanation: 示例供应商1承诺1500分，合格收货1300分，差额200分为尚未完成的承诺价值线索；净开票1400分减付款900分得到未付500分。供应商2余额−50分，表示净付款超过净应付，应核查预付、贷项和超付；供应商3没有记录仍显示零。追查示例采购行1合格8件，发票A先分6件，B开4件仅剩2件可分；B票面440分，分配计价200分，差240分且已付300分，应优先复核，不能直接将300分认定为损失。C没有付款，虽有差异但不进入已付款异常清单。供应商汇总差额不能替代逐发票三方核对。

checkpoints.name: a
checkpoints.label: 按供应商汇总承诺及收货金额
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: b
checkpoints.label: 按供应商汇总开票与付款
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 20-16：按发票日期、发票号、行编号顺序分配采购行合格收货；每行最多分得当前开票量与剩余合格量的较小值，余额不低于零；合并至发票粒度后筛选已付款且数量或金额不一致的发票。

mergeExamples.label: 采购承诺与收货汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 采购承诺按订购金额，收货按合格数量乘采购单价。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH suppliers(supplier_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_po_lines(supplier_id,ordered_cents,accepted,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1000,8,100),(1,500,5,100),(2,400,0,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,600,600,0),(1,800,300,500),(2,100,150,-50)), a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY ordered

mergeExamples.label: 净开票及付款汇总
mergeExamples.explanation: 净开票已扣批准贷项，余额可为负。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH suppliers(supplier_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_po_lines(supplier_id,ordered_cents,accepted,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1000,8,100),(1,500,5,100),(2,400,0,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,600,600,0),(1,800,300,500),(2,100,150,-50)), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY billed

mergeExamples.label: 供应商敞口报表
mergeExamples.explanation: 分别预聚合再连接供应商主档，保留无交易供应商。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH suppliers(supplier_id) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3)),
v_po_lines(supplier_id,ordered_cents,accepted,unit_price_cents) AS (VALUES (1,1000,8,100),(1,500,5,100),(2,400,0,100)),
v_invoice_balance(supplier_id,billed_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents) AS (VALUES (1,600,600,0),(1,800,300,500),(2,100,150,-50)), a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC

mergeExamples.label: 分配合格收货
mergeExamples.explanation: 同一采购行的合格数量只能分配一次，按发票顺序分配。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH receipts(po_item_id,accepted,unit_price) AS (VALUES (1,8,100),(2,0,100)),
invoices(invoice_id,invoice_date,invoice_no,paid_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'2025-02-01','A',600),(2,'2025-02-02','B',300),(3,'2025-02-03','C',0)),
lines(line_id,invoice_id,po_item_id,qty,price) AS (VALUES (11,1,1,6,100),(21,2,1,4,110),(31,3,2,2,100)),
seq AS (SELECT l.*,i.paid_cents,r.accepted,r.unit_price,COALESCE(SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.po_item_id ORDER BY i.invoice_date,i.invoice_no,l.line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_qty FROM lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id=l.invoice_id JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=l.po_item_id),
allocated AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_qty THEN 0 WHEN accepted-prior_qty<qty THEN accepted-prior_qty ELSE qty END matched_qty FROM seq),
checked AS (SELECT invoice_id,MAX(paid_cents) paid_cents,SUM(qty) billed_qty,SUM(matched_qty) matched_qty,SUM(qty*price) face_cents,SUM(matched_qty*unit_price) expected_cents FROM allocated GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT line_id,qty,prior_qty,matched_qty FROM allocated ORDER BY qty

mergeExamples.label: 已付款异常发票
mergeExamples.explanation: 发票层判断存在数量或金额差异且已经发生付款；未付款异常不进入此清单。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH receipts(po_item_id,accepted,unit_price) AS (VALUES (1,8,100),(2,0,100)),
invoices(invoice_id,invoice_date,invoice_no,paid_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'2025-02-01','A',600),(2,'2025-02-02','B',300),(3,'2025-02-03','C',0)),
lines(line_id,invoice_id,po_item_id,qty,price) AS (VALUES (11,1,1,6,100),(21,2,1,4,110),(31,3,2,2,100)),
seq AS (SELECT l.*,i.paid_cents,r.accepted,r.unit_price,COALESCE(SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.po_item_id ORDER BY i.invoice_date,i.invoice_no,l.line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_qty FROM lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id=l.invoice_id JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=l.po_item_id),
allocated AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_qty THEN 0 WHEN accepted-prior_qty<qty THEN accepted-prior_qty ELSE qty END matched_qty FROM seq),
checked AS (SELECT invoice_id,MAX(paid_cents) paid_cents,SUM(qty) billed_qty,SUM(matched_qty) matched_qty,SUM(qty*price) face_cents,SUM(matched_qty*unit_price) expected_cents FROM allocated GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT invoice_id,paid_cents,billed_qty,matched_qty,face_cents,expected_cents,face_cents-expected_cents variance_cents FROM checked WHERE paid_cents>0 AND (billed_qty<>matched_qty OR face_cents<>expected_cents) ORDER BY paid_cents DESC
